column1: # Your gold set's queries, one per line: qid<TAB>class<TAB>text<TAB>origin, separated by tabs.
# origin is hand when you wrote the query yourself and claude when a model drafted it; at least 10 must be hand.
# class is a word you choose, for example identifier, paraphrase or mixed as in the shared sets; scores are reported per class.
# Lines that start with # are comments, so delete these lines or keep them, as you like.

column3: Man summons a knight from the past and has to compete in a battle royale to have his wish granted.

Man finds book where any name he puts in kills them so he uses it to kill villains and outwit police
Guy explores the seas and finds a crew in hopes of becoming the pirate king
